why: Current references have Vertical, Horizontal, and Diagonal Length all set to 50 with Glow Rotation = 0, so they cannot isolate which ray helper or angle/length table entry is mismatched.

Ghidra/objdump shows FUN_181150790 returns a scalar that is stored per ray and later passed into the vtable aggregation path; existing fd90-exact probes clear much of final aggregation but do not distinguish per-ray scalar semantics.
Single-ray references are needed before further image-only tuning of OLMKiraKira, otherwise ray order, angle mapping, helper scalar use, and OpenCV primitive residuals are entangled.

inputs.description: Use the same source artwork as refs/win_references/20260604_olm/OLMKiraKira so current residuals are comparable.
Fully opaque high-contrast grid/points source, useful if the current artwork is not easy to reuse.

cases.reason: Isolate the vertical ray helper and final aggregation argument order.
Isolate the horizontal ray helper and 0-degree/axis handling.
Isolate the +45-degree ray and angle table mapping.
Isolate the -45-degree ray and Diagonal2 parameter mapping.
Separate Brightness Gain from Strength/seed exponent behavior for the vertical ray.
Separate Brightness Gain from Strength/seed exponent behavior for the horizontal ray.
Separate Brightness Gain from Strength/seed exponent behavior for the +45-degree ray.
Separate Brightness Gain from Strength/seed exponent behavior for the -45-degree ray.
Optional angle-table sanity check for Glow Rotation and diagonal base-angle mapping.

manifest_requirements: Record all OLM Kira Kira property names, match_names, property_index, values, enabled/active state, and selected effect path.
Record project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value per render set.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
If possible, preserve the same comp size and source layer artwork used by refs/win_references/20260604_olm/OLMKiraKira.
mac_follow_up: Run existing OLMKiraKira Python/C++ smoke probes against the single-ray cases.
Use the single-ray diffs to decide whether to continue with helper-return scalar aggregation probes or angle/length table mapping probes.
